subject.title: fix(gateway): add separate inline avatar size cap for agents.list projection

question: For valid avatars above the inline projection budget, should agent-list consumers receive no visible avatar, a generated thumbnail, or a lazy-loadable dedicated-avatar reference?
rationale: The patch intentionally makes previously accepted 256 KiB–2 MiB local avatars disappear from projected identities; source inspection cannot determine whether that compatibility tradeoff matches intended product behavior.

options.title: Thumbnail or reference
options.body: Keep valid avatars visible while bounding `agents.list` with a small projected thumbnail or cacheable dedicated-avatar reference.

options.title: Omit oversized avatars
options.body: Accept that oversized valid avatars disappear from projections and require client-fallback, documentation, and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Thumbnail or reference
recommendation.body: Keep valid avatars visible while bounding `agents.list` with a small projected thumbnail or cacheable dedicated-avatar reference.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame ties the complete gateway agent projection and latest avatar-path ownership to their merged work.
